title: SOKIMO employees’ sit-in reported in early October as a late-September action
location: Kinshasa; exact sit-in site not stated in body
notes: MINES.CD body published 3 October says Kinshasa-based SOKIMO employees held a sit-in “le week-end dernier” as part of planned actions. The calendar day is not established, so timing is coded only to September. The same body records 118 months of salary arrears and demand for the state-portfolio company’s director general to leave. No attendance is reported. This is an earlier-onset continuation, not a new October event.

notes: Search-result-only report says strike began 16 Sep and was suspended 2 Oct over road bottlenecks/taxes/wage policy. This is a continuation, not October onset; no body or attendance evidence. A work stoppage/traffic obstruction alone is not coded as a qualifying gathering.
